RESULT [weeds]: All three models reached at least 92% mAP@0.5 in-season, with drops of up to 14.5% cross-season. I3Net domain adaptation recovered only 1.4% (YOLOX) and 3.3% (YOLOv8). Numbers are from the published abstract (via OpenAlex, and the ASABE abstract at https://elibrary.asabe.org/azdez.asp?JID=5&AID=54499&CID=oma2023&T=2).
US [weeds]: CottonWeedDet12 is one season from one site, so a model that scores 0.90 on the cwd12 holdout says little about a new field. The loop should keep at least one out-of-season holdout, for example the 2022/2023 subsets of 3SeasonWeedDet10, next to the sealed cwd12 holdout, and judge each increment on both. The survey README is also a source list the collector can harvest from.
CORRECTION [weeds]: Confirmed: Ecological Informatics 81:102546 (2024), Deng, Lu and Xu. The abstract gives 36 datasets, in-season mAP@0.5 of at least 92%, cross-season drops of up to 14.5% (especially for YOLOX and YOLOv8), and I3Net gains of 1.4% (YOLOX) and 3.3% (YOLOv8).
